definition: Flatten the account for the day once equity is at or below (1 - limit) times the equity at the day's start.
boundaries: The day boundary is the host's (the article uses the broker's server midnight) and it passes day_start_equity; a new day releases the halt. Equity includes floating results, as the article's combined daily result does. The limit is his to set: its default is the risk session's placeholder. No host runs halts yet, so this halt acts only where a host passes it these statistics.
recognition: After a set loss in one day the account is closed out until tomorrow.

sources.quote: if the limit is breached, immediately closes all open positions, cancels all pending orders
